parts.html: The K-01 standard model is a classic L-shaped kitchen in a striking green with an acrylic stone countertop. Solid-color painted fronts look crisp and elegant, while the L-shaped layout fits work zones and cabinets along two walls.
Hettich hinges with soft-close mechanisms let the doors close smoothly and silently, and the drawers glide out on concealed Actro YOU Hettich runners.
Drawer runners: concealed Actro YOU Hettich.
We make the K-01 to fit your kitchen — in a different length, with a different front color, or with an island — and install it in Bratislava and Vienna.
